investment_strategy: Constructive-but-selective AI leadership barbell for the next 12–18 months. With the VIX near 13 and indices trending higher, we lean into quality AI platforms while respecting 4%+ Treasury yields and rich tech valuations. Overweight cash-generative, moat-heavy cloud/software platforms (Microsoft, Alphabet) and keep a smaller, high-beta allocation to the AI compute leader (NVIDIA). Size positions to cushion regulatory and China-related risks, and to balance momentum with lower volatility and strong fundamentals.
